items.question: Adrenaline is the drug of choice for?
items.explanation: Adrenaline (IM) is first-line in anaphylaxis - it reverses bronchospasm, hypotension and oedema.

items.question: Beta-blockers are contraindicated in which condition?
items.explanation: Non-selective beta-blockers can cause bronchospasm and are relatively contraindicated in asthma.

items.question: Tamsulosin improves benign prostatic hyperplasia symptoms by blocking?
items.explanation: Tamsulosin is a uroselective alpha-1A blocker relaxing prostatic smooth muscle.

items.question: Epinephrine reversal (vasodepressor effect) occurs after pretreatment with?
items.explanation: With alpha blockade, epinephrine's beta-2 vasodilation dominates, lowering BP (epinephrine reversal).

items.question: Nirmatrelvir (with ritonavir) treats COVID-19 by inhibiting the viral?
items.explanation: Nirmatrelvir inhibits SARS-CoV-2 3CL (main) protease; ritonavir boosts its levels.

*PharmaCraft Daily - 12 Nov 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (ANS)
Q: Adrenaline is the drug of choice for?
Ans: Anaphylaxis
Why: Adrenaline (IM) is first-line in anaphylaxis - it reverses bronchospasm, hypotension and oedema.

🌍 *FMGE* (ANS)
Q: Beta-blockers are contraindicated in which condition?
Ans: Bronchial asthma
Why: Non-selective beta-blockers can cause bronchospasm and are relatively contraindicated in asthma.

🩺 *NEET PG* (ANS)
Q: Tamsulosin improves benign prostatic hyperplasia symptoms by blocking?
Ans: Alpha-1A receptors
Why: Tamsulosin is a uroselective alpha-1A blocker relaxing prostatic smooth muscle.

🏥 *INI-CET* (ANS)
Q: Epinephrine reversal (vasodepressor effect) occurs after pretreatment with?
Ans: Alpha blocker (e.g., phentolamine)
Why: With alpha blockade, epinephrine's beta-2 vasodilation dominates, lowering BP (epinephrine reversal).

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper IV: Recent Advances)
Q: Nirmatrelvir (with ritonavir) treats COVID-19 by inhibiting the viral?
Ans: Main protease (3CL protease)
Why: Nirmatrelvir inhibits SARS-CoV-2 3CL (main) protease; ritonavir boosts its levels.
